name: VRM_REV_ADJ_LINE_CONTS_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Revenue document line unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_CODE
columns.description: Contingency code on the revenue line.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Date the contingency expires on the revenue line.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days from the Date considered for fulfillment to automatically consider the additional satisfaction event as fully satisfied.

columns.name: EXPIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the contingencies are expired on the revenue line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PRIMARY_REMOVAL_EVENT
columns.description: The primary contingency removal event on the revenue line.

columns.name: OPTIONAL_REMOVAL_EVENT
columns.description: The optional contingency removal event on the revenue line.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date the contingency was expired on the revenue line.

columns.name: REASON_REMOVAL_DATE
columns.description: Date the contingency was removed on the revenue line.

columns.name: EXPIRED_BY
columns.description: Who column: displays the user who expired the contingency.

columns.name: DEFAULTED_IN_VRM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the contingency was defaulted based on a rule.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments entered by the user during the add revenue contingency adjustment process.

columns.name: ASE_FULFILLMENT_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Date that is considered for the automatic fulfillment of additional satisfaction events. The additional satisfaction event is considered to be fulfilled when the number of days specified in the setup have elapsed starting with the selected date. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DATE_ADDL_SATIS_EVENT.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_REVENUE_AMOUNT
